contentPattern.structure: full-bleed photo with a contained teal overlay panel: eyebrow + serif heading + coral CTA. Includes a `rewards` modifier for a full-width solid teal band (icon + heading/body + CTA laid out horizontally).

modifiers.rewards: Full-width solid teal CTA band: inline gift icon, heading with italic accent word + body copy, and a coral CTA — row layout on desktop, stacked on mobile. No background photo/contained panel.

suitableFor: promotional banners with a contained color panel over a photo
